A.2
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No......561
Date....9.-.9.-.16....

8th September 1916.

Sir,
On the 7th inst. a memorial service was held at
22 Zung Nyeu Li 仁之里 Frenchtown in honour of the
late Zee Kyl Vung 徐金文 , a rebel leader who was
executed at Peking two years ago.

The activities of Han Hwe 韩顺 , the so called
labour leader, still continue. He is reported to be
renting a number of houses in Frenchtown to be occupied
by strikers of the poorer class who are unable to buy
food and therefore disposed to surrender.
It is also reported that Han Hwe was trying to get
the position of Chief of Police which will soon be
vacant, but has now given up the idea in favour of
Waung Yang Ngoo 王养吾 , an Anhwei man, who was one
of the promoters of the recent meeting in the City
which was banned by the Police. Han Hwe now hopes
to secure the position of Military Commissioner at
Chinkiang when the impending re-shuffling of posts
takes place.

General Yang received a telegram on the 7th inst
from Peking asking for more cavalry to be sent to
Mongolia and he is to consult with General Lu on the
subject.

On the 7th inst a representative of the President
arrived at Shanghai and presented to General Tsai Ao
a quantity of medicine and an autograph letter as a
mark of special favour.

The painters strike is still on.

Your obedient servant,

[签名]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（左侧批注：15/5）
（左侧批注：[签名]）
（底部手写批注：... 22/1 8/8）

A.2
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科）

上海工部局。

刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记册
编号......561
日期....1916年9月9日....

1916年9月8日。

先生：

本月7日，在法租界仁之里22号举行了一场追悼会，以纪念两年前在北京被处决的反叛领袖徐金文 (Zee Kyl Vung)。

所谓劳工领袖韩顺 (Han Hwe) 的活动仍在继续。据报，他正在法租界租赁多处房屋，供那些无力购买食物、因而倾向于妥协的贫困阶层罢工者居住。

另有报告称，韩顺曾试图谋求即将空缺的警察局长一职，但现已放弃此念，转而支持王养吾 (Waung Yang Ngoo)。王系安徽人，是近期市内一次被警方禁止的集会的发起人之一。韩顺目前希望在下一次即将到来的职位调整中，获得镇江军事委员的职位。

杨将军于本月7日收到来自北京的一封电报，要求增派骑兵前往蒙古，他将就此事宜与卢将军商议。

本月7日，总统代表抵达上海，向蔡锷将军赠送了一批药品及一封亲笔信，以示殊恩。

油漆工罢工仍在进行中。

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

首席侦探督察。

警务处总监。

（左侧批注：15/5）
（左侧批注：[签名]）
（底部手写批注：... 22/1 8/8）
